artifact_inventory.purpose: Symbolic verification of the Bernstein stability identity and finite sparse-grid matrix check for the sharp SSPRK(3,3) threshold.
Executed verification output for the sharp CFL constant and finite sparse-grid matrix check.

limitations: The theorem treats linear constant-coefficient periodic transport, the standard piecewise-constant total-level sparse-grid upwind DG discretization, exact arithmetic, and L2 one-step stability. It does not cover nonlinear or variable-coefficient problems, higher spatial degree, limiters, arbitrary adaptive/downward-closed index sets, internal-stage stability, or finite precision. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.
provenance: Numerical analysis of Runge--Kutta stability for the piecewise-constant sparse-grid DG transport operator introduced in arXiv:2609.17312.
record_title: Sharp SSPRK(3,3) CFL for piecewise-constant sparse-grid DG
